title: Chapter 354: Faceless Man
content:
Chapter 354: Faceless Man

The battle was about to start.

Wang Shuo's recent experience with spearmanship has deepened a lot, and he was just looking for an opponent to test it out.

So, he didn't release the control skill right away.

Instead, he pointed the spear at the opponent's chest. This move was just to test the opponent's depth and was not very aggressive.

The opponent immediately used a sword to push the spear away, and Wang Shuo felt the force from the spear.

Both sides were attacking tentatively, trying to find the opponent's flaw.

Just as the opponent approached and wanted to attack Wang Shuo's right hand holding the gun, Wang Shuo felt that this move was not easy to defend, so he directly used "iron chain binding".

Before Wang Shuo could make another move.

The opponent actually lost his voice and said, "You actually have a confinement skill."

"I give up."

His figure suddenly blurred and disappeared from the arena.

Wang Shuo also teleported out quickly.

Wang Shuo was surprised. Could this control skill be very precious?

After thinking about it for a while, I'm afraid it is true.

Wang Shuo only found skills with similar effects in a few secret books in the Ksitigarbha Pavilion.

It seems that in the future, it is better not to use this skill unless it is absolutely necessary.

I don’t know whether this skill can be preserved in the future after it is completely de-digitized.

It is estimated that it is impossible.

Then I have to think of another way and find another technique with a confinement skill.

Then, Wang Shuo signed up again.

This time, the opponent was an opponent holding a double blade.

Judging from the figure, it should be a woman.

Wang Shuo was also constantly trying his own moves.

He first tried the "Abyss Swamp" skill and found that there was no problem.

The woman on the opposite side immediately fell into the swamp.

But she was agile, and she stepped lightly in the mud twice with her feet, and she actually flew into the air, and then took advantage of the force in the air and jumped more than ten meters.

This operation stunned Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo quickly tried his newly learned "Swift Wind Step"

In the past ten days, Wang Shuo also learned a body movement to make up for his lack of speed.

Wang Shuo moved quickly at the edge of the swamp tentatively and found that he did not fall into the swamp.

This result made Wang Shuo feel mixed.

Although he could move quickly in the swamp.

But if the opponent had also practiced similar skills, his swamp trap would be of no use.

The woman with the double blades looked at Wang Shuo's behavior and felt a little funny.

She immediately approached Wang Shuo quickly from the edge of the swamp.

Wang Shuo flew directly into the swamp.

After a while, Wang Shuo found again that if he did not move quickly, he would still fall into the swamp.

And using the wind step for a long time consumes a lot of internal strength.

Wang Shuo simply could not bear it for a long time.

So, Wang Shuo also left the swamp and chose to fight with the opponent in close combat.

This time Wang Shuo did not use the imprisonment skill, but continued to use the dragon attack and ordinary attacks.

The opponent also fought him on equal terms.

The fight lasted for more than ten minutes, but Wang Shuo was the better one in the end, and used the move "Dragon Out of the Sea".

He directly knocked his opponent back, and although the opponent was seriously injured, he did not die immediately.

The opponent immediately chose to admit defeat.

Wang Shuo was also injured in this battle, and his injuries did not disappear when he came out of the arena.

This made Wang Shuo's heart jump, and he must fight according to his ability in the future.

After winning two games, Wang Shuo was already familiar with the process of the arena, so he did not continue to challenge.

He got two more Shura Orders, and with Wang Shuo's previous ones, there were a total of 10.
